run_f_gold_minimum_swaps: run f_gold to compute minimum swaps to bring elements less than or equal to k together
test_f_gold_with_array: test f_gold with an array, its length, and threshold k to find minimum swaps needed
summarize_f_gold_sliding_window: summarize the f_gold sliding window algorithm that counts bad elements in each window of size count
refactor_f_gold_to_pythonic: refactor f_gold to use Pythonic constructs like sum and generator expressions instead of manual loops
review_f_gold_edge_cases: review f_gold for edge cases like empty arrays, all elements above k, or all elements below k
